title: Proof Protocol
concept: Change = behaviour + observable evidence + time window. Promises without windows are hope fog.
whenToUse: After any meaningful change request; when “I promise” appears without a plan; ending Hope-Based Repair.
steps: Define evidence — what counts as met/partial/missed.
Set window — start, end, review ritual.
Track simply — tally or table; facts first at review.
Review — extend, adjust, or close; Team Frame on.
Escalate if misses dominate without ownership.

phrases.text: I need proof, not a promise. Behaviour: ___. Evidence: ___. Window: ___. Review: ___.
I’m committing to ___, visible as ___, through ___.
At review we’ll look at the record first.

working: Pause+Return always includes exact time; 14-day log; six of six returns kept → trust moves.
notWorking: “I’ll be better at communication.” No behaviour, evidence, or window. Soothes briefly; changes nothing.
activity: Write one Proof item today: Behaviour / Evidence / Window / Review. Both initial.
